packageRules.description: Batch routine patch updates into one weekly PR
Auto-merge patch PRs once CI is green

Skip terragrunt 1.1.4: it fails to load AWS config when a CA bundle is set (see the Dockerfile ARG). Patch updates auto-merge here, so without this the fix is reverted on the next run. Drop this rule once a release carries the fix.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes get their own PR immediately, outside the weekly batch, and are never auto-merged. This replaces a packageRule that matched the category 'security' -- no such category exists, so it never applied.
